description: Runnable static frontend starter with instant preview.

defaults.headline: Starter Foundry Frontend
defaults.subheadline: A fast first artifact for UI prompts.

buildHints.whenToUse: Pure static landing page served by `serve` (no framework). Use when the product is truly a marketing landing page or a static doc site — NOT for apps with state.
firstSteps: Edit `index.html` and `app.js` directly. No build step; `serve -l 3000` is all you need.
Brand strings: inline in `index.html`. Palette: inline `<style>` or separate `.css`.

placeholders.description: Default landing with generic hero/feature/CTA blocks. Replace ALL content for the product — the default is placeholder-only.
Optional interactivity entry. If the landing is truly static, delete the file + its script tag.
